payload.headline: Successful HWPX manipulation requires handling fragmented XML placeholders and clearing layout-cache elements to prevent rendering glitches.
payload.evidence: Placeholders may be fragmented across multiple XML tags (e.g., <hp:t>{{event</hp:t><hp:t>_name}}</hp:t>). HWPX files often contain layout-cache elements (e.g., <hp:lineSegArray>) that store pre-calculated text positions. Removing these elements from modified paragraphs ensures the application recalculates the layout correctly upon opening.
payload.mediator_reasoning: The task was successful, but the specific technical nuances of HWPX (fragmented tags and layout caches) are valuable reflections for the Planner to ensure future HWPX-related tasks are handled with similar precision.

Using regex-based string replacement on the raw XML content effectively handles the common issue where XML tags split placeholders.
